purpose: Preregister official ANA/GeoIDEP geoservice acquisition for reproducible Ica and Arequipa hydrographic geometry without guessing endpoints or promoting unverified geometry.

official_registry_sources.registry_evidence: GeoIDEP lists ANA Unidades Hidrográficas as available with OGC WMS and OGC WFS.
official_registry_sources.intended_use: Acquire official hydrographic-unit geometry and parent-code attributes; freeze exact query, CRS, response bytes and SHA-256 before map publication.
official_registry_sources.forbidden_use: Do not invent an endpoint, infer local channel axes from basin polygons, or publish geometry without a reproducible service response and parent-code validation.

official_registry_sources.registry_evidence: GeoIDEP lists ANA Eventos emergencias hídricas as available with OGC WMS and OGC WFS; the catalog says records are sourced or verified from COE or INDECI reports.
official_registry_sources.intended_use: Cross-check dated hydric-emergency records against bounded INDECI/COEN evidence while keeping event geometry separate from hydrographic geometry.
official_registry_sources.forbidden_use: An emergency record does not prove a ravine footprint, outlet, receiver overflow, activation threshold or negative control.
